svg.title: How the screenshots renew themselves
svg.desc: After a change of main that touches a file of .github/screenshots-paths.txt, after every release, every week and on demand, the screenshot bot looks for scripts/screenshots.sh; without it, the bot renders nothing. The script renders the pictures without secrets, and each picture whose pixels stayed the same keeps its committed file. When pixels changed, one pull request from bot/screenshots holds the new pictures and merges itself once every check passes; when main looks as rendered, the bot closes it. So every picture shows the project as it is.
